mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, medicine_name, dosage, frequency, start_date, end_date, notes FROM t_medication WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_medication (user_id, medicine_name, dosage, frequency, start_date, end_date, notes) VALUES (#{userId}, #{medicineName}, #{dosage}, #{frequency}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{notes})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_medication SET user_id=#{userId}, medicine_name=#{medicineName}, dosage=#{dosage}, frequency=#{frequency}, start_date=#{startDate}, end_date=#{endDate}, notes=#{notes} WHERE id=#{id}
